name: Depeche Mode
hook: An Essex synth-pop band signed on a handshake, whose records were in the mix Detroit's techno founders grew up on.
blurb: Depeche Mode formed in Basildon, Essex, in 1980: Dave Gahan, Martin Gore, Andy Fletcher and Vince Clarke. Daniel Miller of Mute Records saw them play at the Bridge House in Canning Town, in east London, and signed them on a spoken agreement, without a written contract. Their first single, 'Dreaming of Me', came out in February 1981. Clarke left in November 1981 and formed Yazoo, Gore became the songwriter, and Alan Wilder joined in 1982. Gore described what they were aiming for as soul music played on electronic instruments, and Kraftwerk is among the influences they have named. In Detroit, the teenagers who went on to invent techno were listening to Depeche Mode alongside Kraftwerk and funk: Wikipedia's article on Detroit techno lists them among the records the Belleville Three bonded over.
